# supabase-js

`supabase.js` is the UMD build of `@supabase/supabase-js` 2.58.0 (https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js),
copied unchanged from the npm package (`dist/umd/supabase.js`). It is served from this folder, never from a CDN.
It exposes the global `supabase` (`supabase.createClient`).
